name: paperseek
description: PaperSeek is an open-source, AI-powered literature search tool for researchers. It helps turn your research question into search queries, discover papers across academic sources, and organize the results for review.

paragraphs: PaperSeek turns a research question into a reading list. It plans and refines queries, retrieves candidate papers from your chosen scholarly source, expands citations where supported, and ranks relevance to the question. You can inspect the process, explore connections, save results, and develop a cited review from selected abstracts.

Start with a question, not a perfect query. Describe the relationship, method, population, or research gap you want to investigate. PaperSeek translates it into source-specific searches and refines them using retrieval feedback.
Connect papers instead of reading a flat list. OpenAlex citation expansion follows references and citing works. The interactive map provides another route through the literature around your results.

requirements.text: You do not need a PaperSeek account for Community.
Community is built for one user in a trusted environment and has no sign-in.
